Six equal dots.
Three rows, aligned right.
The original wordmark.
The reference supplies the symbol. The supplied brand kit supplies the lettering, type system and colours.

pages.title: A consistent six-dot mark.

pages.title: The same typography.

pages.name: Typography

elements.text:
Clear thinking. Useful systems. Thoughtful design.
Use Inter for body copy, interface text and everyday communication.
Custom ddc outlines + outlined Inter Display Regular north. The complete v1 wordmark geometry is retained.
Exact font files are included. The live-text logo remains an editable approximation.

pages.title: A system built from the dots.
pages.subtitle: Repeat or crop the six-dot motif for supporting graphics. Keep the logo itself complete.
pages.name: Patterns and icons

elements.text: These icons are functional graphics. Use the six-dot symbol as the brand identifier; keep supporting graphics secondary.

pages.title: Ready for everyday use.
pages.subtitle: Editable layouts retain the original dimensions, placeholders, palette and font families.
pages.name: Applications

elements.text: Replace bracketed fields in SVG files. The included template PDFs are layout proofs with placeholder content.

Standard symbol height. Use the micro variant for smaller screen icons.
